summary: Frontend verification of Scope Calculator tier gating + Team-tab calculator-access assignment control. OWNER, SALES, CREW-no-access, ASSIGNMENT flow (grant/toggle/remove), and SURVEY-tier login all verified via Playwright. 8 of 9 review scenarios PASS. One real bug found: SURVEY tier still sees $ amounts on Items (specialty handling bill), Access (stairs/stops bill) and Materials (per-unit price) rows because those inline labels are not gated by showPricing/showBuild — violates the 'no pricing anywhere' spec for survey access.

ui_bugs.issue: Survey tier (scope-no-pricing-card visible) still renders 11 dollar-amount strings on the page: '$500'/'$800'/'$400' etc. next to specialty items (piano, safe, pool table, moto), '$85' and '$125' next to stairs/extra-stops access rows, and '$15 ea / $12 ea / $25 ea' next to Materials rows. Spec says 'NO dollar amounts anywhere on the page' for survey tier. Fix: wrap the `$${it.bill}` (line 566), `$${a.bill}` (line 593) and `$${m.price} ea` (line 605) with `{showPricing && …}` so they hide when tier==='survey'.
Non-owner tiers (sales, survey) still see the subtitle 'Owner tool — scope, range, and firm pricing.' — cosmetically inaccurate for non-owner tiers. Minor.

action_items: Gate the inline `$` labels on ITEMS (line 566), ACCESS (line 593) and MATERIALS (line 605) behind `showPricing` in ScopeCalculator.jsx — survey tier currently leaks 11 dollar amounts.
Optional: soften PageTitle subtitle on /scope-calculator for non-owner tiers.
critical_code_review_comments: ScopeCalculator.jsx is now 813 lines (was 694). Still over the 700-line threshold; prime candidate for extracting ROOMS/ITEMS/ACCESS/MATERIALS constants into a `scopeData.js` module and the pricing engine `price()` into a `useScopePricing` hook.

Tier gates (isOwner/isFinalTier/isSurvey/canFinal/canSurveyToggle/showBuild/showPricing) are computed in one place and mirrored well on the range/final/margin/calibration/load-card blocks. The three inline `$` labels on line 566/593/605 are the only cases that skip the `showPricing` gate.
Small: `getScopeAccessApi().catch(() => setTier('none'))` swallows errors silently; a 500 on that endpoint would show 'No calculator access' to an owner. Not currently observed but worth logging.

success_rate.frontend: 89% (8/9 review scenarios pass; 1 real leak found)

rca of the issue: SURVEY $-leak: lines 566/593/605 of /app/frontend/src/pages/ScopeCalculator.jsx render `$${it.bill}` (Items), `$${a.bill}` (Access) and `$${m.price} ea` (Materials) unconditionally. The pricing gate `showPricing` is only applied to the range/final band, price-build stats, and the 'lb payload' hint. Reproduction: log in as any user granted `calculator_access='survey'`, open /scope-calculator, scroll to Items/Access/Materials rows — dollar figures like `$500`, `$85`, `$15 ea` are visible next to row labels. Mitigation: wrap those template literals with `{showPricing && …}` (or omit the ` · $X` segment when `!showPricing`).
